slots.heroHeading: Turn Your Memories Into Storybook Art
slots.description: ["Bring a favourite memory to life with a hand-drawn Ghibli style portrait by a human artist. Inspired by soft painterly backgrounds, rounded features, gentle light, and storybook warmth, each illustration turns you, your family, your partner, or your pet into an original character. This is fan-art inspired artwork rather than a copy or impersonation of a copyrighted character, so your portrait remains personal and recognisably yours.","A studio Ghibli style portrait illustration can capture the details that make someone unmistakable: a familiar smile, distinctive hair, glasses, freckles, wrinkles, or a pet’s expressive personality. Relaxed poses and natural daylight work beautifully, while outdoor photos can inspire meadow, beach, porch, or train-ride settings. You can also describe a fictional background, outfit, mood, or colour palette for the artist to weave into the scene. Family and couple photos are welcome, and multiple people or pets can share one gentle, nostalgic composition.","Your commission starts at $39.99. After you order, a human artist creates a first preview within 72 hours, then you can request unlimited free revisions until the artwork feels right. Whether you are looking for a studio Ghibli style portrait example for a thoughtful gift or a ghibli style portrait illustration for your own wall, Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon-inspired styles. Explore our [custom anime portraits](/) or read the [Ghibli-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/ghibli-style-inspired-custom-poster) for ideas on turning your artwork into a larger keepsake."]
